description: This database is stored in a SQLite database and contains detailed information about music tracks. It serves as the primary source for the content of each track, including title, artist, album, etc.
This table contains all the tracks, including potential duplicates generated from different sources. Each row represents a single track record with a unique track_id.
Unique identifier for the track record in this database.
Identifier of the source from which the track record originates.
Original track identifier from the source; uniqueness is not guaranteed.
Name of the track’s artist or band.
Name of the album in which the track appears.
Length of the track (in seconds or formatted string).

This database is stored in a DuckDB database and contains sales information for the tracks in the tracks_database. It provides details about individual sales transactions, including the number of units sold and the revenue generated.
This table contains individual sales transactions for tracks. Each row represents a single sale record for a specific track_id.
Unique identifier for the sale record.
Identifier linking the sale to a track in the tracks table.
Country in which the sale occurred.
Store or platform where the sale occurred.
Number of units sold in this transaction.
Revenue generated in USD from this sale.
